title: The Signal at 37.5 — 72 Seconds That Never Came Twice
description:
At 22:16 EDT on 15 August 1977, the Big Ear radio telescope in Delaware, Ohio recorded a narrowband signal 30x the surrounding noise. It lasted 72 seconds. It has never been heard again.

This is the story of those 72 seconds: the machine that heard them, the printout that recorded them, the three days before a human noticed, and the half-century of silence since. The film shows what is known, what is contested, and says plainly where the evidence stops — the Wow! signal is not explained in this film, because it is not explained in the literature.

Made in code: every image is drawn (14,019 frames), the score is synthesised, the narration is a synthetic voice. Any printout or scene shown is a reconstruction and is labelled as one on screen.
